summary: Iter12 — full backend + frontend regression for Vivo CRM v2 (timeline, churn-reasoning, duplicates, UPT, return-rate trend, channel-attribution, templates performance + 18 templates incl. Swahili, daily-goal, winback-bulk, preferences extras, follow-ups page, data-quality page). Backend 17/17 passed (2 skipped due to pre-existing seed bug — associate session has role='manager' so 403 enforcement on /customers/duplicates + /dropoff/winback-bulk cannot be verified via that seed). Frontend: daily-goal-card + progress + edit + save all working, /follow-ups page renders with 3-tab strip + 35 open/3 overdue/2 done, customer profile timeline tab default with churn-reasoning-card + timeline-events, preferences tab gains colour_palette/style_avoids/preferred_store/preferred_channel (all 4 inputs + save present), customer book filters strip with 7 tier buttons + city + sort dropdown, Overview channel-attribution-card + return-rate-card render, sidebar nav-data-quality + /data-quality page with 88 dedup groups visible. No console errors beyond pre-existing Recharts width warnings. No 404s on any existing endpoints — confirms single include_router fix is healthy.

minor.issue: daily_goal=0 falls back to default 5 instead of clamping to 1 due to truthiness bug `int(payload.get('daily_goal') or 5)` on L897. Negative values would also fall back. Clamp first, then default. Bounds for >50 work correctly.

Cannot verify associate->403 — seeded associate session in test_credentials.md has role='manager' on /api/auth/me. Pre-existing seed-data bug, not introduced this iteration. require_manager dependency is wired correctly in code.

ui_bugs.issue: Last-contact info renders as visible text 'Never contacted' but the element is missing data-testid='last-contact-{customer_id}'. 0 of 24 cards expose the selector. Visual UX is fine — only test/automation hook missing.
RfmBadge visually rendered next to name (e.g. 'VIP' next to Janet Masinde) but element lacks data-testid='rfm-badge'. Review item explicitly calls for this testid.

data-testid='dropoff-winback-bulk' button not rendered. May be correct (Projected Churn 30D shows 0 → button conditionally hidden when high===0 per spec). Cannot independently verify the click->task-creation+toast flow on UI because no high-band customers exist in the drop-off forecast right now. Backend POST /api/dropoff/winback-bulk works (Iter12 backend test passes).

issues: Console: multiple Recharts 'width(-1) and height(-1)' warnings on initial mount — pre-existing, charts still render correctly after layout settles.

action_items: Add data-testid='last-contact-{customer.customer_id}' to the 'Never contacted' / 'Last contact ...' span in CustomerSearch.jsx card row (review explicitly calls for this).
Add data-testid='rfm-badge' to the RfmBadge component used in CustomerProfile.jsx header next to the customer name.
Fix daily_goal=0 fallback bug in server.py L897 — replace `int(payload.get('daily_goal') or 5)` with `int(payload.get('daily_goal', 5))` so clamp() can take it down to 1.

Reseed associate session so /api/auth/me returns role='associate' (currently 'manager'). Without this, manager-only-route 403 tests cannot run for ANY future iteration. Pre-existing — not introduced here.

Optional: verify dropoff-winback-bulk visibility logic when drop-off forecast has 0 customers in the 'high' band — confirm spec is 'shown when high>0' (current behaviour) and not 'always shown disabled'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~2017 lines (was 1500+ last iter, 2.8x past the 700-line guideline). The new v2 block (~1465-1690) is a good candidate to split into /app/backend/routes/v2.py or per-domain modules (timeline.py, dedup.py, bi.py).

PUT /api/dashboard/me/goal silently clamps out-of-bounds inputs instead of 422-ing. UX-friendly but hides client bugs. Consider returning 422 for goal<1 and >50, or at least include {clamped: true, requested: <n>} in the response so the UI can warn.
CustomerProfile.jsx is 1070 lines — also past 700-line guideline. Timeline tab, Preferences tab, and the AI script card could each be their own component.
Recharts width=-1 warnings on Overview mount are noisy in console — set explicit min-width on the ResponsiveContainer parent (or aspect ratio) to silence. Pre-existing.
